description: Land Title Settlement Department - Puwakpitiya (Part), Galewela D/S Division, Matale District - Cad. Map No. 310086
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including details of ownership, property boundaries, encumbrances, and servitude rights. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land registration and property ownership matters, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
